title: Long Nap Recovery Tradeoff
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=apple:health metric=nap
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(nap_min) as nap_min, max(next_day_hrv) as next_day_hrv by person _time
| where nap_min>90
| sort - nap_min
description: Uses Apple Health nap exports telemetry to monitor very long daytime naps and the next-day recovery context in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for patterns where long naps may be compensating for poor overnight rest, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Apple Health nap exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily table of nap duration and next-day HRV.
grandmaExplanation: It lists very long daytime naps and the next-day recovery context so you can spot patterns where long naps may be compensating for poor overnight rest before it becomes annoying.
